note: The Town of Eastend's in-town campground on the west side of town in a bend of the Frenchman River, where you can fish or launch a kayak; it is next to a playground, ball diamonds, the swimming pool and splash park and the Streambank Golf Course, and has barbecues, picnic tables and a sheltered cook area.  Sites are open grass around the ball diamonds; site 11 is short (20 ft).  The camp manager's line, May to September, is 306-295-7186. --Claude
summary: Keep (town campground, all nightly). 42 sites, C$20-45, Let's Camp live; 50 A on the full-service row 27-43, max 90 ft, one pull-through. Riverview -> not waterfront: the stream is ~14-16 m wide (creek-size) and every Let's Camp site photo of the river rows (17-43) shows riparian scrub and the far cut bank, no water. Season 05-15..09-30 (2026). Pin, phone, websites unchanged.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverview -> not waterfront (no --AWH value). The Frenchman River here measures about 14-16 m on Esri z18 - under the ~30 m river threshold, so at most a creek, and the vocabulary has no creek-view value. The river rows (sites 17-26 along the north road, about 49.5185,-108.8273, and 27-43 along the NE road) sit 30-40 m from the water behind a continuous band of riparian willow and scrub; Let's Camp's photo of every one of those sites faces the river and shows the scrub and the eroded far bank, with no water visible. The stored evidence (posts ~9 m from the water behind a 6-8 m willow thicket) agrees that creekside is not earned.
SITES: stored 43 -> 42 (site 12 is not available; Let's Camp lists 42). Site 11 is 20 ft and site 10 is 25 ft (Let's Camp); others 24 ft and up.
SEASON: opens 05-15 from the town's 'starts on May Long Weekend' (2026); closes 09-30 is the end of the manager's May-September season and the package window, not a posted closing date.
